text:
Barcelona bought Rodri.
                                      
                    Rodri has been a key player for his previous clubs.
                    The midfielder has also been a regular for Spain, winning the 2020 European Championship, the 2022 Nations League and the 2026 World Cup.
                    Rodri won the 2023 Ballon d'Or, and he is considered one of the best midfielders in the world.
                    For Barcelona, the signing of Rodri is a major coup, and it will strengthen their midfield as they look to challenge for the La Liga title and the Champions League.
